basic_profile.bio: Just a regular dude from Mumbai, India, trying to navigate the vast world of Reddit. I'm a huge fan of anime and video games, especially Call of Duty Zombies and JuJutsu Kaisen. When I'm not gaming or binge-watching, I'm usually checking out Indian movie scenes or some quirky gacha content. I'm an IT support specialist by day, and I usually hop online after work hours, around 7 PM IST. In a relationship, but always looking for ways to improve things in the bedroom. Not very familiar with all the ins and outs of Reddit yet, so bear with me!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly lies in tech support and troubleshooting, thanks to my job in IT. I picked up a lot of knowledge about anime and gaming through countless hours of watching and playing. I’m just starting to learn more about sexual health and relationships through Reddit threads.
